name: Question 7
problem:
Consider the curve defined parametrically as 

$$
x=2\operatorname{sin}⁡t,\,y=2\operatorname{cos}⁡t,\,t\in [0,\pi ].
$$

What integral gives the surface area generated when this curve is rotated $2\pi $ radians about the $y$-axis?

Question 7
?

Consider the curve defined parametrically as x=2sin⁡t,y=2cos⁡t,t∈[0,π]. What integral gives the surface area generated when this curve is rotated 2π radians about the y-axis?

a
22π∫0πsin2⁡tdt
b
8π∫0πsin⁡tdt
c
4π∫0πcos2⁡tdt
d
8π∫0πcos⁡tdt
e
22π∫0πsin⁡tcos⁡tdt
